Cellular Therapy Unit - Admission Note
Date of service: 2032-06-16

The patient is admitted for planned infusion of an autologous anti-CD19 CAR-T cell product for relapsed diffuse large B-cell lymphoma after two prior lines of therapy. Lymphodepleting chemotherapy with fludarabine and cyclophosphamide was completed as an outpatient. Cell infusion is scheduled for 2032-06-18.

Past medical history is notable for hypertension, well controlled on amlodipine, and remote migraine without aura, with no episodes in more than ten years.

Pre-infusion neurologic baseline, assessed 2032-06-16 at 10:30: ICE score 10/10. The patient is alert, fully oriented, and conversing normally. Cranial nerves are intact, strength is 5/5 throughout, and there are no focal deficits. Handwriting sample obtained for later comparison.

Plan: infusion on Day 0, ICE screening at least twice daily from Day 0, vital signs every 4 hours, levetiracetam prophylaxis per unit protocol.
